pages.text: Follow moves after the owner; Wait pauses ordinary work. All new, recovered, and revived companions start in Wait. First specialization also waits. Ordinary world reloads retain saved orders.

Mining uses Mine, carriers Haul, signaling slimes Watch, combat and dragons Fight, cleaners Clean, farmers Farm, and lumberjacks Chop. Healers use Search, warehouses Store, fishers Fish, abundance Nurture, and tunnelers Tunnel. Soggy, Meow, and Attention Slimes can Roam; Meow activation is independent.

Primary and shared owners may manage or recover a companion. Giving a recovered item to someone else does not change ownership. Workers, healers, and carriers cooperate within the same owner’s team or between mutually shared owners.
